A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DDIM-GMM work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including material relocated or renumbered in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments on CelebAHQ, FFHQ, and ImageNet, including FID/IS results, parameter-sharing comparisons, and qualitative samples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds text-to-image and LSUN evaluations, parameter ablations, and a DPM-Solver comparison.

M1.justification: Equation 9 changes the RAND offset rule from s times the centered vector to s times its unit-normalized direction. This revises one variant's stated procedure; the mixture kernel, other variants, and training objective remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether retained experiments were rerun.

E1.justification: v2 adds caption-conditioned text-to-image evaluation on 30,000 COYO-700M pairs using Stable Diffusion v2.1, plus LSUN Bedroom and Church evaluations. These extend the original face-generation and class-conditional ImageNet coverage to additional tasks and domains.

E2.justification: DPM-Solver, previously cited without an empirical comparison, becomes an evaluated comparator against DDIM-GMM-ORTHO-VUB on classifier-free ImageNet generation in Appendix A.11 and Table 2. Comparator membership in the retained DDIM/DDPM experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: v2 adds a separate Stable Diffusion protocol generating 30,000 images at 256x256 resolution with 5/10 steps and guidance scale 7.5. It also introduces controlled mixture-count sweeps over 8, 256, and 1024 components. The original face/ImageNet settings and offset-search range remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond v1's sampler-variant and step-sharing comparisons, v2 adds explicit mixture-count and offset-scale sensitivity studies in Appendix A.9, and reports comparing offsets shared per batch versus across the sample set in A.10. Three 100-step qualitative comparison grids are removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report point FID/IS estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical testing procedures. The added experiments do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Original table values are retained, while v2 adds COYO, LSUN, ablation, and DPM-Solver results. For example, Table 2 reports FID/IS of 6.94/207.85 for ORTHO-VUB versus 9.75/225.68 for DPM-Solver at 10 steps and guidance 2.5: better FID but worse IS. The 100-step qualitative grids are removed.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.7 introduces a discrete Dirac-mixture data assumption and a Bayes-rule derivation of the denoising conditional distribution in Equations 32–33. The existing moment-matching, variance-bound, forward-process, and ELBO derivations in Appendices A.3–A.6 remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and three enumerated contributions retain their central claims. The introduction and conclusion extend the empirical scope to text-to-image generation, with the conclusion newly claiming improvements over DDIM using few sampling steps in that task.

C2.justification: v2 substantially expands the original latent-exploration interpretation with arguments about multimodal denoising and convergence of sampler behavior at many steps. Appendices A.9–A.10 explain parameter-dependent failures and memory/covariance feasibility limits at high latent dimensionality. The conclusion removes v1's proposed offset-scheduling explanation and future direction.

D1.justification: Appendix A.10 newly documents precomputing and caching offsets and sharing them across batches or the entire sample set. v2 also identifies the Stable Diffusion checkpoint and specifies stochasticity settings for retained qualitative samples. The original architecture, noise schedule, and variance-clipping details are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Guo et al. (2023) and Xiao et al. (2022) to motivate multimodal denoising, alongside references for COYO-700M, LAION-5B, and LSUN. The existing related-work discussion in Appendix A.1 remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction and conclusion receive limited rewriting. Unguided ImageNet discussion and qualitative results move into the appendix, and text-to-image receives a main-text subsection. The overall narrative structure and most existing prose are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds four plots and three comparison tables, relocates the unguided ImageNet figure, and places the existing face-result tables together. The original ten-step sample images are retained, with the unguided grid enlarged and rearranged; three 100-step grids are removed.

improvement.justification: The added evaluations, DPM-Solver comparison, and targeted ablations strengthen evidence for applicability and parameter choices beyond v1. However, Equation 9's new individual normalization of centered RAND offsets need not preserve Equation 8's required zero weighted mean. This unresolved consistency problem tempers the empirical gains.
